parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to obtain the Bastionhost instance ID.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance for which you want to export the configuration backup.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).
